reason: Both operate accredited for-profit postsecondary institutions delivering mainly online (plus some campus) degree, certificate and diploma programs to adult students, earning tuition revenue. APEI runs American Military University, American Public University, Rasmussen and Hondros. Perdoceo runs CTU and the AIU System (with online, campus and hybrid programs from non-degree through doctoral). Both serve working adult learners, and their program lines overlap in online degrees and healthcare education. APEI has a military/veteran and nursing focus. Perdoceo has more business, IT and culinary programs. This is a difference in emphasis, not in kind.
